evidence.title: Record, train, and deploy from one place with Strands Agents, LeRobot, and Hugging Face Storage Buckets

summary: Hugging Face introduces an integrated platform for recording, training, and deploying AI models, combining Strands Agents, LeRobot, and Storage Buckets. The new tools streamline end-to-end AI development workflows for developers and enterprises.
title: Hugging Face Unveils Unified AI Development Platform with Strands Agents, LeRobot, and Storage Buckets
